source_claim: NBCUniversal’s official Tenchi Muyo! TV information identifies Kiyone (清音) in the cast and describes her as Mihoshi’s partner; it distinguishes the TV series continuity from the OVA series.
notes: Kiyone is explicitly named in the official franchise cast page; her appearance is tied to the TV/spin-off continuity. No claim that the official OVA continuity includes her as a main roster member.
